{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0
print(f"Sentinel value {-999.0} appears in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(sentinel_value).any()}")

# Count how many times it appears
sentinel_count = df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(sentinel_value).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values: {sentinel_count}")

# Check if any other invalid values (e.g. negative or NaN)
invalid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: x < 0 or pd.isna(x))
print(f"Any invalid values (negative or NaN): {invalid_baseline.any()}")

# Look at the distribution of valid biomarker_baseline values
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'][(df['biomarker_baseline'] >= 0) & (~df['biomarker_baseline'].isna())]
valid_mean = valid_baseline.mean()
valid_count = len(valid_baseline)

valid_mean, valid_count"}
